autoresponder.title: Auto Responder
autoresponder.enabled_desc: Automatically replies to incoming guest messages. Sensitive cases trigger an alert.

autoresponder.prompt_placeholder: e.g. Be very warm. Mention free parking. Do not share the access code before D-2.

autoresponder.test_booking_id_hint: If provided, the actual booking context is used for the AI reply.
autoresponder.test_message_placeholder: e.g. Hi, what time can I check in?
autoresponder.test_would_reply: Reply that would have been sent
autoresponder.test_would_send_transitional: Transitional message that would have been sent
